{%- liquid assign selected_variant = product.selected_or_first_available_variant assign product_form_id = 'ProductForm-' | append: section.id assign fact_material = '' assign fact_detail = '' assign fact_carry = '' case product.handle when 'velantra-vivienne' assign fact_material = 'commerce.facts.vivienne_material' | t assign fact_detail = 'commerce.facts.vivienne_detail' | t assign fact_carry = 'commerce.facts.vivienne_carry' | t when 'velantra-delphine' assign fact_material = 'commerce.facts.delphine_material' | t assign fact_detail = 'commerce.facts.delphine_detail' | t assign fact_carry = 'commerce.facts.delphine_carry' | t when 'velantra-juliette' assign fact_material = 'commerce.facts.juliette_material' | t assign fact_detail = 'commerce.facts.juliette_detail' | t assign fact_carry = 'commerce.facts.juliette_carry' | t when 'the-colette-wool-tote' assign fact_material = 'commerce.facts.colette_material' | t assign fact_detail = 'commerce.facts.colette_detail' | t assign fact_carry = 'commerce.facts.colette_carry' | t when 'velantra-boat-tote-2' assign fact_material = 'commerce.facts.camille_material' | t assign fact_detail = 'commerce.facts.camille_detail' | t assign fact_carry = 'commerce.facts.camille_carry' | t when 'velantra-margot-tote' assign fact_material = 'commerce.facts.meridian_material' | t assign fact_detail = 'commerce.facts.meridian_detail' | t assign fact_carry = 'commerce.facts.meridian_carry' | t endcase assign fact_material = section.settings.fact_material | default: fact_material assign fact_detail = section.settings.fact_detail | default: fact_detail assign fact_carry = section.settings.fact_carry | default: fact_carry assign preorder_kind = '' assign preorder_message = '' case product.handle when 'velantra-vivienne' if settings.vivienne_preorder != false assign preorder_kind = 'october' assign preorder_message = 'commerce.product.preorder_october' | t assign preorder_message = settings.vivienne_preorder_message | default: preorder_message endif when 'the-colette-wool-tote' if settings.colette_preorder != false assign preorder_kind = 'early_october' assign preorder_message = 'commerce.product.preorder_early_october' | t assign preorder_message = settings.colette_preorder_message | default: preorder_message endif when 'the-eleanor-weekender', 'velantra-weekender' if settings.weekender_black_preorder != false assign preorder_kind = 'black_september' assign preorder_message = 'commerce.product.preorder_black_september' | t assign preorder_message = settings.weekender_black_preorder_message | default: preorder_message endif endcase assign is_preorder = false if preorder_kind == 'october' or preorder_kind == 'early_october' assign is_preorder = true elsif preorder_kind == 'black_september' and selected_variant.option1 == 'Black' assign is_preorder = true endif assign standard_lead_time = section.settings.lead_time | default: '1–2 business days to process' assign preorder_lead_time = section.settings.preorder_lead_time | default: preorder_message assign displayed_material = fact_material if selected_variant.option1 == 'Black' and section.settings.fact_material_black != blank assign displayed_material = section.settings.fact_material_black endif assign purchase_disabled = false if selected_variant.available == false or selected_variant.price == 0 assign purchase_disabled = true endif -%}
